name: jira_get_issue_development_info
description:
Get development information (PRs, commits, branches) linked to a Jira issue.

This retrieves the development panel information that shows linked
pull requests, branches, and commits from connected source control systems
like Bitbucket, GitHub, or GitLab.

application_type.description: (Optional) Filter by application type (case-sensitive). Examples: 'stash' (Bitbucket Server), 'bitbucket', 'GitHub', 'githube' (GitHub Enterprise Server), 'GitLab'. If omitted, types are discovered automatically.
